paper_title: A selenophene substituted double-cable conjugated polymer enables efficient single-component organic solar cells

knowledge_points.content: PBDBPBI-Se is a double-cable conjugated polymer synthesized via Stille polymerization, consisting of a conjugated backbone of chlorinated benzodithiophene (BDT) and benzo[1,2-c:4,5-c']dithiophene-4,8-dione (BDD) with perylene bisimide (PBI) units attached as electron-withdrawing side chains.
knowledge_points.evidence: PBDBPBI-Se was prepared by using Stille polymerization similarly to PBDBPBI-S... based on electron-donating conjugated backbones containing chlorinated benzodithiophenes (BDTs) alternating with 5,7-bis(2-ethylhexyl)benzo[1,2-c:4,5-c0 ]- dithiophene-4,8-dione (BDD) units and electron-withdrawing side units containing PBIs.

knowledge_points.content: Single-component organic solar cells based on PBDBPBI-Se achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 6.25%, with a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 12.68 mA cm^-2, an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.84 V, and a fill factor (FF) of 0.58.
knowledge_points.evidence: Finally, a high efficiency of 6.25% could be obtained... providing a high efficiency of 6.25% with a high photocurrent of 12.68 mA cm^-2... Voc of 0.84 V and FF of 0.58.

knowledge_points.content: Substituting thiophene with selenophene in the double-cable polymer backbone results in a red-shifted absorption spectrum by approximately 30 nm and raises the HOMO energy level from -5.59 eV (for PBDBPBI-S) to -5.44 eV (for PBDBPBI-Se).
knowledge_points.evidence: PBDBPBI-Se had a ~30 nm red-shifted absorption spectrum compared to PBDBPBI-S... The highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) levels... are -5.59 eV for PBDBPBI-S and -5.44 eV for PBDBPBI-Se.

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations show that selenophene-substituted backbones in double-cable polymers possess more planar structures compared to the twisted structures found in thiophene-containing backbones.
knowledge_points.evidence: We also use density functional theory (DFT) calculations to study the geometry of the conjugated backbones, in which we found that selenophene substituted backbones showed planar structures compared to twisted thiophene-containing backbones.

knowledge_points.content: Thermal annealing at 230 °C for 10 minutes significantly improves the photovoltaic performance of PBDBPBI-Se SCOSCs, increasing the PCE from 1.52% for as-cast films to 6.25%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The SCOSCs based on the PBDBPBI-Se thin film without thermal treatment exhibit a PCE of 1.52%... When the thin films were thermally annealed at 230 °C... the PCE of the SCOSCs based on PBDBPBI-Se was enhanced to 6.25%.

knowledge_points.content: PBDBPBI-Se exhibits ambipolar charge transport in organic field-effect transistors (OFETs); after annealing at 280 °C, it demonstrates a hole mobility of 3.6 x 10^-1 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 and an electron mobility of 1.7 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1.
knowledge_points.evidence: Studies of OFETs showed that PBDBPBI-Se had temperature-dependent mobilities with the best hole mobility of 3.6 × 10^-1 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 and electron mobility of 1.7 × 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 after thermal annealing at 280 °C.

knowledge_points.content: Grazing-incidence medium-angle X-ray scattering (GIMAXS) reveals that PBDBPBI-Se has a lamellar d-spacing of 4.7 nm, which is notably smaller than the 6.9 nm d-spacing observed in the thiophene-based PBDBPBI-S.
knowledge_points.evidence: However, we noted that peak q1 had a d-spacing of 4.7 nm in PBDBPBI-Se, which was much smaller than that in PBDBPBI-S (6.9 nm).

knowledge_points.content: The absence of phase transitions in DSC measurements for PBDBPBI-Se suggests that its highly crystalline conjugated backbone hampers the crystallization of PBI side units due to poor crystalline cooperativity.
knowledge_points.evidence: the absence of a phase transition in PBDBPBI-Se revealed that the PBIs in PBDBPBI-Se had disordered nanostructures. This is reasonable since in PBDBPBI-Se the conjugated backbones have strong crystallinity, which will hamper the crystallization of PBIs due to the poor crystalline cooperativity.

knowledge_points.content: PBDBPBI-Se demonstrates high thermal stability with a 5% weight loss temperature of 418.0 °C, as determined by thermal gravimetric analysis (TGA).
knowledge_points.evidence: the temperatures with 5% weight loss for PBDBPBI-S and PBDBPBI-Se are 413.8 °C and 418.0 °C.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis indicates that thermal treatment at 230 °C causes a transition in PBDBPBI-Se films where (h00) diffraction peaks shift from appearing in both in-plane and out-of-plane directions to predominantly the in-plane direction.
knowledge_points.evidence: the diffraction peaks (h00) appeared in the out-of-plane (OOP) and in-plane (IP) directions when the thin films underwent no thermal treatment, while they appeared in the IP direction after thermal treatment at 230 °C.
